signUp.termsBody:
Welcome to MyLedja.

By creating an account you agree to use MyLedja for your own personal money tracking. You must give accurate details, keep your sign-in safe, and follow applicable law.

MyLedja is provided as-is. We work to keep the service available and secure, but we do not promise uninterrupted access. You may close your account at any time from Settings.

We may update these terms. When we do, we will show the new terms in the app. Continued use after an update means you accept the change.

If you do not agree, do not create an account or use MyLedja.
signUp.privacyBody:
Privacy notice (Nigeria NDPA)

MyLedja is a personal finance app. This notice explains what we collect and why, so you can agree before you create an account.

What we collect
• Account details: your name, email address, and a hashed password (or a Google sign-in id when you choose Continue with Google).
• Money data you enter: accounts, balances, transactions, budgets, bills, goals, debts, payees, and related notes. This stays in your workspace and is used only to run the features you use and to sync across your devices.
• Device and session data: a device name, sign-in tokens, and basic technical logs needed to keep you signed in securely and to prevent abuse.
• Optional: if you turn a feature on later (for example bank connections, file attachments, or AI help), we collect only what that feature needs and tell you at that point.

Why we process it
We process your data to create and secure your account, provide the service you asked for, send sign-in and security codes, meet legal duties, and improve reliability. Your agreement at sign-up (this tick) is our consent record for account creation under the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA).

Sharing
We do not sell your data. We share data only with processors that help us run MyLedja (for example hosting and email delivery), under agreements that protect it, or when the law requires it.

Your choices
You can download or delete your data from Settings when those tools are available, or contact support. You may withdraw consent by closing your account; that stops further processing except where we must keep records by law.

Contact
Questions about privacy: use Help in Settings. We will update this notice when our practices change.

reports.about.netWorth: What you own minus what you owe at the end of each month. Investments count at their latest price. Adjustments, write-offs and unrealised gains each have their own column.
reports.about.cashFlow: Where money came from and where it went, from each transaction's type, not just its sign.
reports.about.budgetProgress: What you planned for each month against what you spent.
reports.loadFailed: Could not load this report. Check you are online.

health.advice.saving: Spend less than you earn: look for categories to trim
health.advice.runway: Add {amount} a month to your emergency fund
health.advice.debt_load: Your debt payments take a large share of your income
health.advice.bills: {count} bills were paid after their due date
health.formula.saving: Income minus spending, divided by income, over the last three full months. 20% or more scores 100; nothing saved scores 0.
health.formula.runway: The cash in your counted accounts, less money you borrowed recently, divided by your usual monthly spending on essentials. Reaching your target scores 100.
health.formula.debt_load: Your average monthly debt payments divided by your average monthly income. 10% or less scores 100; 50% or more scores 0.
health.formula.bills: Bills paid by their due date, divided by bills due, over the last three full months.
health.formula.budget: Categories that stayed within their plan last full month, divided by the categories with a plan.
health.stressNote: A {amount} cost comes out of your cash. Nothing here is saved.

rules.splitMustTotal: Split must total 100% or the full amount
